http:request.doc:name: Ask Groq with tools

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { question: vars.question, finishReason: payload.choices[0].finish_reason, toolCalls: payload.choices[0].message.tool_calls default [], content: payload.choices[0].message.content }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- [ { role: "system", content: "You are an order support assistant. Use a tool when you need order data. Never guess an order status." }, { role: "user", content: vars.question } ]
%dw 2.0 output application/json var m = payload.choices[0].message --- { role: "assistant", content: m.content, tool_calls: m.tool_calls }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.messages ++ [ vars.assistantMsg, { role: "tool", tool_call_id: vars.toolCall.id, content: write(payload, "application/json") } ]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { question: vars.question, toolUsed: vars.toolCall.function.name, toolArguments: read(vars.toolCall.function.arguments, "application/json"), answer: payload.choices[0].message.content }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { question: vars.question, toolUsed: null, answer: payload.choices[0].message.content }

http:request.doc:name: Groq chat completions
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- { model: "openai/gpt-oss-120b", messages: vars.messages, tools: vars.tools, tool_choice: "auto", stream: false }]
